general_information.Description: This course provides a comprehensive overview of the events industry, equipping students with the knowledge and skills required to plan and execute successful events. Students will explore the key characteristics of events, examine the role of industry bodies, and analyze the events business as a service industry. The course delves into the scope and impact of events on society, the economy, and politics, while offering a thorough understanding of event planning processes, including budgeting, marketing, and logistics. It places strong emphasis on strategic event management, project management techniques, and risk management strategies. A highlight of the course is the opportunity for hands-on experience through a real-world project, where students will apply their learning to organize a complete event.
general_information.StudentTasks: 1. Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination 2. Actively participate in class activities 3. Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class 4. Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose 5. Read the textbook in advance 6. Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/gui/Home) for up-to-date information and material of the course. 7. Complete course's Portfolio with full contents of exercises and submit to the teacher after the course.
general_information.Tools: Individual tools prepared by students: Laptop

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Identify the key characteristics of events, events industry bodies, in order to understand the business of events management as a service activity.
Comprehend the events industry's size, market dynamics, demand factors, and its societal, economic, political, technology influenced and developmental consequences.
The ability to conduct detailed planning, execute plans, manage risks, budgets, and teams, as well as evaluate outcomes for project success.
Understand the full lifecycle of event planning and execution from inception to completion.
Foster global citizenship by cultivating high ethical standards, individual strength, and a collaborative spirit.

assessments.Question Type: group exercises: presenting and explaining an event topic
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: - Students build a short event proposal the reasons for choosing the topic and have 10 -15 minutes to present and Q&A - Students need to focus on the topic and avoid going off topic
assessments.Grading Guide: - Guided by instructor - Students and instructors ask questions and give ideas for the final project - Key points of assignments may be announced to students during presentation - A good assignment: well presented presentation; thoughtful topic; creative idea; effective budget estimation; strong team spirit

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: The detailed plan should include:: event theme, venue, time, budget, financial operations, logistics plan, time management schedule, marketing and risk management plan
